response.sql:
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  GROUP BY t.observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  telescope_count,
  telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_telescope_count
FROM station_stats
ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_telescope_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count per station is the unweighted mean across stations that have at least one telescope; stations with no telescopes are not represented in the schema’s telescope rows.
